finalText:
The bug was premature rounding. The `computeTotal` function was rounding to 2 decimals twice (once after the percent discount, once after the flat discount) before converting to the target currency. This lost precision in intermediate calculations.

When you stacked coupons with currency conversion, those rounding errors compounded. For example, with GBP and a 10% discount on $19.98: the code rounded $17.982 to $17.98, then converted (17.98 × 0.78 = 14.0244), which rounded down to 14.02. But the correct path keeps precision through (17.982 × 0.78 = 14.02436), which rounds up to 14.03.

Removed the two intermediate `round()` calls on lines 24 and 27 — now the code rounds only once after converting to the target currency, matching the reference implementation. All 40 tests pass.
